name: XDKNet 2.7.0
body:
Android TV 2.7.0. Watch Parties need the server plugin update that comes
with it: XDKNet plugin 2.1.0.17 (Emby 2.0.5.17). Everything else works with
plugin 2.1.0.16 as well.

TVs on 2.4.10 or later offer this update on their own. On 2.4.9, use
Settings > About > Check for updates. Anything older has to install it once
by hand, from the `XDKNet_AndroidTV.apk` below.

More from Moonfin 2.7 to 3.1. Apart from the new Settings screen, nothing
changes how the app looks until you choose it.

## Watch Parties

A room on your server for watching together, on Jellyfin and Emby alike,
once the server has plugin 2.1.0.17.

- Start one, join one with its six-letter code, scan its QR code, open an
  invite link, or pick it from the server's list of rooms.
- The host picks what everyone watches, or puts films to a vote. A show or a
  season stands for its next episode.
- Everyone's player moves together. Over the video it says who paused,
  skipped, joined or left, and counts down the start.
- Chat and reactions sit behind the party button in the player, with quick
  replies in place of typing on a TV.
- A room can have a PIN, and the host can hand the room over or let everyone
  control playback.
- Home leads with a Watch Parties row while there are rooms to join, and
  Watch with group on a title's page brings it to the room.
- They sit behind the SyncPlay switch, under Settings > Playback & SyncPlay,
  where the page is called Watch Parties on a server that hosts them. With
  the switch off, or on a server without the plugin update, nothing changes.

The SyncPlay screen has a new look too: cards for the group you are in, its
queue and the groups you can join, with each person's picture.

## Settings

- Settings fills the screen. The categories sit in a bar along the top next
  to search, and Left and Right move between them. Settings opens on Account
  & Security.
- Beside the list, a live preview draws Home or a title's page as the
  setting being changed would make it, before anything is saved.
- On a TV the remote starts on the category bar. Down goes into the
  settings, and Back leaves a screen, then returns to the bar, then closes
  Settings.

## Details screen

- **Frost**, a fourth new style under Settings > Personalization > Details
  Screen > Details Screen Style: the title in a glass window over its
  blurred artwork, with tabs for the overview, episodes, cast, More Like This
  and the rest, so nothing scrolls off the screen.
- **Sections**, on the same screen, hides parts of a title's page: the logo,
  tagline, version badge, cast, directors and writers, chapters, extras, More
  Like This, reviews and a person's biography. One switch covers every style.
- An episode's season list opens on that episode, not the season's first.
- Episode pages add the show's regular cast after the guest stars.
- The file badges read DV P8, HDR10+, HDR10, HLG or SDR instead of the
  server's own names.
- The buttons under a title appear together, a moment after the page, rather
  than one by one.
- Marking an episode played moves a show's Next Up on.
- A playlist's page has Sort By and Filters, which change only the view, not
  the playlist.
- A collection opens in the order it is kept on the server, not by release
  date. Release order is still in its sort list, and a Custom order still
  wins.

## Home

Under Settings > Personalization > Home Screen.

- **Peek Home Rows** shows the top of the first row under a full-screen
  media bar.
- **On Now** is a Home row of its own, to place anywhere.
- **New Release Banner** flags New Series, New Season or New Episodes in the
  media bar, and a **Source** setting can fill the bar with only those.
- **Home Screen Backdrop**: Full Screen as before, Corner, Top or Off.
- IMDb, TMDB and Seerr list rows can be sorted by name, release date,
  rating, popularity or at random.
- **Modern cards on My Media row** can be turned off for plain landscape
  library tiles.
- Home Rows lists the rows that are on first, and folds the ones that are
  off into groups by kind.
- Pressing Home while on Home brings a new set of titles into the media bar.

## Libraries

- In a library's Sort & Filter, each filter group has its own Clear, and a
  long list of values gets a search box. Accents don't need typing.
- **Folder View** in Sort & Filter lists a library folder by folder, as it
  is laid out on the server.
- **Titles Under Posters**, under Settings > Personalization > Libraries,
  can be turned off for a grid of artwork alone.
- **Show Libraries Individually**, under Settings > Personalization >
  Navigation, gives each library its own button in the side menu.
- A search box over a list no longer misses the first word typed into it
  from the TV keyboard.

## The player

- **Cinema Mode Skip Button**, under Automation & Queue, puts a Skip button
  on trailers and pre-rolls. Fast Forward skips too.
- Subtitles can be **bold**, with a **stroke width** and a **shadow**,
  under Subtitle Customization.
- **Subtitle Download Languages** searches up to five languages at once.
- **Transcode Audio Codecs** has the server convert the audio formats you
  pick, for a soundbar that mishandles DTS or Opus, while the picture plays
  untouched.
- ASS subtitles follow Subtitle Size. Anyone with it away from 20 will see
  them change size.
- Credits skipped on their own mark the episode watched, as pressing Skip
  already did.
- On the Fire TV models that show a black screen for a video carrying both
  Dolby Vision and HDR10+, Advanced Options has a switch to play it as
  HDR10+.
- The player no longer redraws everything every second while the controls
  are up.

## Live TV

- With Use External Player on, Live TV channels now open in the external
  player. Before, the channel stayed black. **Live TV Only**, beside the
  switch, sends only live channels out and keeps films in XDKNet.

## Also

- Seerr's Discover has a Search button beside Requests.
- Counts that read "# participants" or "# rows discovered" show the number.
